div.div:
1. Buyer view scope: returns ONLY origin (department, municipality), processing dates, status, and drying variables (moisture, grain temp) -- zero PII or full trace.
2. Transporter outbox: retains at least 7 days of 5-minute GNSS fixes (2,016 positions); custody events are never dropped and drain before positions.
3. Code & privacy: 80-bit Crockford Base32 + mod-37 check symbol; malformed/unknown/void codes return uniform 'not found'; lookup holds zero grants on internal tables.
4. Recovery targets: sack events RPO 15 min (append-only S3 JSONL export every 60s); public lookup RTO 4 hours (CloudFront + WAF + OAC + buyer_view).
5. Dashed lines = local/physical handover, offline/buffered step, audit log, or response.
